verdict.rationale: FutureHouse/Edison's core purpose is AI-generated insight from user data. Kosmos takes a research objective plus datasets and autonomously analyzes them, generates hypotheses and produces cited, auditable reports. The Analysis agent turns raw experimental data into analyses, statistics and figures, with data upload and artifact review documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor docs), and thin documentation of the in-app UI workflow for bringing your own data, as opposed to the API client.
